deviceQuery.description: The phone the customer wants, as specifically as they said it, e.g. 'iPhone 18 Pro' or 'Pixel 11'.

condition.description: Only set if the customer asked for a new or a pre-owned (used, refurbished) phone.

dataNeed.description: light = mostly on Wi-Fi, moderate = about 60 GB a month, heavy = 100 GB or more, unlimited = wants unlimited data.

international.description: true if the customer calls people or travels outside Canada.

paymentOption.description: save_return = lowest monthly, return the phone after 24 months; finance = keep the phone; trade_in = trading in an old phone; outright = pay the full price now; any = not decided.

maxMonthlyBudget.description: The most the customer wants to pay per month for plan and phone together, in CAD.
